articles.title: UK 'supports Ukraine 100%', Burnham says, after Russia's drone warning
articles.description: Russia accuses the UK of escalating the Ukraine war by supplying British-made drones as the prime minister vows to support Kyiv in its "hour of need".

articles.title: US announces new sanctions on top ICC figures
articles.description: The Trump administration has vowed to dismantle the international court "brick by brick".

articles.title: Inside secret police warehouse as Germany targets small boats gangs
articles.description: German authorities seize dinghies and life jackets during their first raids under a new law that cracks down on smuggling.

articles.title: US tourist killed by lightning strike on Mount Etna during hike in restricted area
articles.description: An American tourist has been killed by a lightning strike after hiking in a restricted part of Mount Etna.

articles.title: Trump downscales 'hostile' military drills with South Korea
articles.description: Joint US military exercises with South Korea will be downscaled, Donald Trump says, as they are "hostile" and too expensive.
